title: Find a suspicious block!
description: The textures of all suspicious blocks have been replaced with more visible ones! They are now much easier to spot while still maintaining the same nice block look.
body:
Now you can easily find suspicious blocks while maintaining their original appearance, 
Like the block's breaking level, its edging will change to a softer, duller color. **enjoy!**
